_about: Hand picks for tools/hd_monsters.py map: tokens with no usable reference mapping (class new), tokens that have no art anywhere (noart), 12 reused-class tokens whose scored pick was plainly the wrong creature (pin overrides), and Ids of vanilla tokens D2R has no unit for (vanilla_ids). Donors are D2R HD units; scale and colour are worked out by the donor scoring for the pinned donor. Picks were made from the donor ranking (tools/hd_monsters.py suggest) and a look at the classic art (NU frame of the token's torso part). Our own work; no Median art in it.
